common.title: IdeaRoute
common.description: An employee feedback operations platform that takes requests from submission and assignment to a decision the author can see.

landing.caseNextStep: Define how catalog entries should be checked and corrected.
landing.adminText: Configure routing by category and monitor the fallback queue.
landing.handlerText: Work on assigned requests, ask for details, and share the outcome with the author.
landing.step4Text: The author sees the decision and next steps. Managers see which requests have a recorded decision and which still need a response.
landing.step4: Share the outcome with the author
landing.label: CRM for employee ideas and concerns
landing.lead: IdeaRoute helps teams take each employee request from submission to response. Requests have an owner, a next step, and a decision the author can see.
landing.employeeText: Share an idea or report an issue and see the reply in your workspace.
landing.managerText: Review requests in your area, assign owners, and record decisions.
landing.step1Text: Choose a category and describe the issue or suggestion. AI can help draft the request.
landing.step2Text: The system registers the request and routes it by category. Requests without a route go to the fallback queue.
landing.step3Text: The owner updates the status, asks for details when needed, and records the decision and next step.
landing.exampleTitle: How a designer gets an answer
landing.exampleText: An item has two identifiers in a specification. The catalog owner confirms which one to use and records the answer on the employee's request.
landing.caseMessage: Inconsistent item names make specifications take longer to check.
landing.caseResolution: Use the current entry in the catalog.
landing.pricingText: Agree on the teams and measures. Compare time to first response and the share of requests with a recorded outcome.
landing.pilot3: Measure response times and the share of requests with an outcome
landing.q1: What happens if a request has no owner?
landing.a1: The request stays in the fallback queue, where an administrator can check the category’s routing rule.
landing.a2: Authors see their own requests. Owners see their assignments, managers see requests in their area, and administrators can see the full registry.
landing.a3: Choose a demo role and explore its workspace with sample requests.
landing.estimateText: Tell us how many departments you want to include and what you want to measure. We’ll use that to prepare your request.
